subject: Re: Procurement pricing & packaging constraints — proposal attached
messages:
From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@novahealthprocure.com>
To: ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
Cc: vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com
Date: Thu, 3 Oct 2024 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Procurement: PO format and invoicing cadence for Redwood services

Hi Ben / Vanessa,

We're preparing the purchase order from NovaHealth procurement but we have a couple of constraints we need confirmed before routing internally:

- PO header must include our ERP token in the "PO Reference" field (format: NH-<BU>-#####). Our AP team will reject invoices without this exact token.
- Invoice cadence: we prefer a monthly consolidated invoice (one invoice per month) rather than multiple ad-hoc invoices. Is Redwood able to deliver a single monthly invoice that lists multiple subscriptions / usage lines?
- Net terms: default is Net45 for our vendors, but for platform vendors we need Net60 due to internal approval cycles. Can you confirm Net60 is acceptable?
- Discount / packaging: procurement wants confirmation on whether volume discounts can be applied as a quarterly slab (e.g., annual commitment tranches recognized quarterly) vs immediate invoice-level discounts. This affects how we map credits in our ledger.

We need a written confirmation for finance and a sample invoice header (or a short note confirming the fields you can populate). If there's a legal/finance contact who can sign off, please include them.

Thanks,
Samantha Lee
Senior Procurement Manager
NovaHealth
Samantha.Lee@novahealthprocure.com
Attachments: none

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@novahealthprocure.com>
Cc: vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com
Date: Thu, 3 Oct 2024 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Procurement: PO format and invoicing cadence for Redwood services

Hi Samantha — thanks for the clear checklist. Quick answers up front:

- PO reference: we can put NH-<BU>-##### into the PO Reference field on the invoice header — we will populate that exactly as provided on the PO.
- Monthly consolidated invoice: yes, we support one consolidated invoice per month that includes multiple usage/subscription lines.
- Net terms: for standard hosted customers our published terms are Net45. We can approve Net60 as a one-time exception tied to the attached quarterly-slab discount proposal (see proposed concession below). Confirming Net60 will need approval from finance (cc'ing Vanessa to expedite).
- Discount/packaging: we can support quarterly slab recognition or invoice-level discounts. Our preference (and easier for reconciliation) is quarterly slab credit that is applied as a post-invoice credit memo each quarter tied to a committed volume band — this keeps the invoice clean for AP while preserving the discount economics.

I'll loop in Vanessa and Marissa internally to get the official finance sign-off and a sample invoice template. I'll follow up with a short PDF that shows the exact invoice header fields we will populate.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive — Redwood Inference

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: ben.carter@redwoodinference.com, marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: Fri, 4 Oct 2024 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Procurement: PO format and invoicing cadence for Redwood services

Ben / Marissa — quick internal note before we reply to NovaHealth. Copying the procurement asks below for context. My read and recommended approach:

1) PO header token: Acceptable. Our billing pipeline can map an incoming PO reference into the "PO Reference" header field on the PDF (and into the AP metadata for ERP matching). Implementation detail: procurement must provide the exact NH-<BU>-##### string on the PO. If the PO omits it we can add a free-text memo but AP may still reject — mark this as MUST-HAVE.

2) Monthly consolidated invoice: Supported. We will generate one invoice per month for the account that lists (a) subscription SKUs, (b) usage token counts, (c) any one-off professional services. That invoice will include line-level metadata for SKU, quantity, unit price, and an optional PO Reference header.

3) Net terms: Finance will allow Net60 only if we align on discount/packaging concessions to protect unit economics. Suggested concession: allow Net60 in exchange for a committed quarterly slab discount structure — i.e., they commit to X monthly minimum throughput per quarter and we apply a 6–10% credit (applied as a quarterly credit memo) if thresholds are met. This prevents cash flow mismatch while giving their AP the longer pay window.

4) Discount mechanics: Recommend quarterly post-invoice credit memo (our standard). Alternate: invoice-level discount if they require immediate reflection, but that complicates ERP matching on their side.

5) PO acceptance evidence: We should attach a sample PDF invoice with the PO Reference in the header and a short one-page note about credit memo treatment. I have a draft SOW and pricing proposal that we can adapt.

Action items: Ben — send the sample invoice and the pricing proposal pdf to Samantha. Marissa — can you confirm the pricing bands below are ok to offer as a negotiation starting point? Proposed quarterly slab bands (examples):
- Tier A: 0–250k tokens/month -> no discount
- Tier B: 250k–750k tokens/month -> 6% quarterly credit if aggregated for the quarter
- Tier C: 750k+ tokens/month -> 10% quarterly credit if aggregated for the quarter

If Marissa signs off, I'll approve Net60 for deal paperwork and Ben can send the formal response.

— Vanessa
VP, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@novahealthprocure.com>
Cc: vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com, marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, 9 Oct 2024 17:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Procurement pricing & packaging constraints — proposal attached

Hi Samantha — thanks for the note and for flagging NovaHealth's AP requirements. Per our internal review we've prepared a short proposal that aligns procurement needs with Redwood's billing controls. Summary below; PDF proposal attached.

Summary of commitments
- PO Reference: We will populate the PO Reference header exactly as provided (NH-<BU>-#####) on every invoice and in the invoice metadata for ERP matching. Please ensure the PO you issue contains that exact string.
- Invoice cadence: One consolidated monthly invoice delivered via email (PDF) and pushed to your SFTP/ERP endpoint if requested. The invoice will include line-level SKU and usage details.
- Net terms: We can accept Net60 for NovaHealth for this contract term conditional on the quarterly slab credit structure described below.
- Discount / packaging: Quarterly slab credits (post-invoice credit memos) rather than immediate invoice-level discounts. Credits will be applied within 14 days after the quarter closes and will reference the originating invoice numbers for traceability.

Proposed quarterly slab (example bands; final bands to be agreed in SOW)
- Tier A (0–250k tokens/mo): 0% credit
- Tier B (250k–750k tokens/mo): 6% credit applied to aggregate quarterly spend
- Tier C (750k+ tokens/mo): 10% credit applied to aggregate quarterly spend

Attachments included: Redwood_Quarterly-Pricing-Proposal_Q4-2024.pdf (PDF) — contains sample invoice header and example credit memo, and SOW-Standard-Managed-Inference_v2.docx (DOCX) — standard terms we will attach to the contract. Also included is a DocuSign link to the MSA + SOW if procurement is ready to proceed: https://www.docusign.com/EXAMPLE/DocuSignLink12345

If these conditions look acceptable, please confirm and provide the exact PO reference string you will use, plus the contact in your AP team for receipt/EDI mapping. If NovaHealth prefers invoice-level discounts instead of quarterly credits, we can discuss but it will require additional mapping on both sides and may impact the concession level.

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick 20-minute call if helpful.

Best regards,
Ben Carter
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0134
